native_v5_status: Failed GUI frameSwapped/presentation gate:1 observed frame and no scene errors. Actual settings Apply, recording and steady phase checks passed before that gate. Tail shutdown and pending-opener checks were not reached in v5; their v4 passing evidence remains separate. No smoke ran in v5. Failure JSON omits whole-run unavailable-frame totals, so those totals are unavailable rather than zero.
ctest_initial_scope: ctest-initial.log records20/20 in20.19s before later startup/teardown fixes. It is retained chronology and does not qualify the final source revision; the final CTest run is separately bound to frozen-v5.

readiness.scope: Read-only readiness snapshot before planned native quiet validation; no profile changes.

native_phase_scope: The no-control5s source-delivery interval has A paused and B playing after200ms settling. Its delta is separate from whole-run unavailable source frames including seeks/priming; no sustained two-deck zero-underrun claim is made.
recording_scope: Native recording is independently parsed as stereo48k float RIFF by the frozen helper and contains only zero master PCM while internal cue is nonzero. Replacement keeps one writer and accepted PCM prefix but omits the wall-time installation gap. Native temporary WAVs are deleted at helper exit; their geometry/hash/readback assertions remain in raw JSON. Private generated WAVs remain ignored/local and can be independently re-read during archive audit.
timing_scope: Per-session stopped execution histograms only; no merged/averaged percentile. Driver discontinuity/recovery observations include capability masks. Missing capability is unavailable, not a measured zero event guarantee. Execution and virtual graph observations do not establish scheduler lateness, physical latency or separate-device drift.
limitations: Both topologies were tested in software on a private virtual graph; no physical multichannel interface or independent hardware clocks were tested.
Native v4 passed; native v5 failed its GUI frameSwapped/presentation gate and must not be counted as a complete passing run.
Native check uses only existing default master with cue disabled; actual settings Apply reinstallation is tested without choosing an explicit physical cue endpoint.
Short quiet integration only; no sustained laptop playback, acoustic quality or click-free qualification.
B-only steady delta and whole-run seek/priming shortages are reported separately. Whole-run source delivery is not gap-free.
Recording queue/disk failures are terminal and can retain a partial file; native successful recording is not a disk-failure stress test.
Immediate-close scenario covers opener completion not delivered before shutdown, not a timed pending-finalizer race or hard disk-operation cancellation.
Ready flags and PCM sample checks are software observations; physical headphone isolation, DAC skew and external patchbay changes remain unverified.
EQ, filters, effects, crossfader processing, jog, gain/transport ramps, tempo/beat features and sustained M1 qualification remain unfinished.
The failed 4.095-second live-stem service p99 target remains a mandatory M2 blocker before a usable release.
